name: Ask To Update A Live Printify Product
description: Ask to change a published Printify product's title, description, tags or prices on the owner's Etsy shop. Nothing changes until the owner approves it in the Control Panel; then Printify edits it and re-publishes only the changed parts. SKUs never change on a live product; never under the 30% margin floor; capped and audited.
requires: the owner's commerce_printify_enabled and commerce_printify_live_update_enabled switches
the owner's approval of each update
